name: PubMed - IADI U1254 CIC-IT Nancy - last 14 days

assignments.name: term
assignments.value: (IADI[All Fields] OR U1254[All Fields] OR CIC-IT Nancy[All Fields]) AND ("last 14 days"[PDat])

parameters.jsCode:
const ids = $json.esearchresult?.idlist || [];
return [{ json: { ids, count: ids.length, empty: ids.length === 0 } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, temperature: 0.2, stream: false, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a biomedical literature analyst. Answer in French. Do not invent facts. For each paper give the objective, methods, main findings, limitations, and why it matters. Clearly say when the abstract is insufficient.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Summarize these PubMed publications published in the last 14 days. Keep one section per paper and add a short overall synthesis.\n' + $json.source }] }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), period: 'last 14 days', count: 0, synthesis: 'Aucune publication PubMed ne correspond aux critères IADI, U1254 ou CIC-IT Nancy sur les 14 derniers jours.', publications: [] } }
